description: This Java source file defines the PickListServices class, which contains service methods related to picklist and order header processing within the OFBiz framework. It includes methods for converting order ID lists to header lists and checking if a picklist bin is complete.

classes.name: PickListServices
classes.description: Service class providing methods for handling picklist operations such as converting order IDs to order headers and checking picklist bin completion status.

methods.name: convertOrderIdListToHeaders
methods.description: Converts a list of order IDs into a list of order header objects, filtering by status and type, and ordering by date.

methods.name: isBinComplete
methods.description: Checks if all items in a picklist bin are completed or canceled, indicating if the bin can be considered complete.
